title: Galaxy Buds On tanıtıldı: Samsung'un ilk klipsli kablosuz kulaklığı
summary: Samsung, kulak kanalını kapatmayan ve yapay zeka özellikleriyle öne çıkan ilk klipsli kablosuz kulaklığı Galaxy Buds On'u duyurdu.
body:
Samsung'un aktardığına göre, şirketin ilk klipsli tasarıma sahip kablosuz kulaklığı **Galaxy Buds On** resmi olarak tanıtıldı. Kulak kanalını kapatmayan açık kulak yapısıyla dikkat çeken bu yeni model, dış mekan aktivitelerinde güvenliği artırmayı ve uzun süreli kullanımlarda konfor sağlamayı hedefliyor.

## Öne çıkan teknik özellikler ve ses teknolojisi

Qualcomm'un Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 Sound Platform çipinden güç alan kulaklıklar, tek şarjla 9,5 saate kadar pil ömrü sunuyor. Samsung, açık kulak tasarımının dezavantajlarını dengelemek için düşük frekansları güçlendiren TwinBoost hoparlörler kullandı. Ayrıca cihazda, çevredeki ses seviyesine göre ayar yapan otomatik ses kontrolü ve sesin dışarı sızmasını önleyen Audio Leakage Reduction teknolojisi yer alıyor.

## Yapay zeka ve satış detayları

Cihaz; Gemini Live desteği, hızlı sesli not alma özelliği ve baş hareketleriyle kontrol gibi yapay zeka yetenekleriyle birlikte geliyor. SamMobile'ın aktardığına göre Güney Kore'de 27 Ekim 2026 tarihinde satışa çıkacak olan kulaklığın fiyatı 299.000 won (yaklaşık 220 dolar) olarak belirlendi ve model ilerleyen dönemde diğer pazarlarda da raflardaki yerini alacak.

**Neden önemli?** Bu cihaz, Samsung'un geleneksel kulak içi tasarım dışına çıkarak ilk kez klipsli form faktörüne yönelmesi ve gelişmiş yapay zeka entegrasyonlarını bu formata taşıması açısından önem taşıyor.

source_texts.text:
Last updated: October 1st, 2026 at 07:18 UTC+02:00
They use Qualcomm's Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 Sound chip.
Samsung
Samsung has unveiled its first clip-on style wireless earbuds, the Galaxy Buds On. They are designed with a comfortable fit and safety for outdoor activities as top priorities. Because they do not block the ear canal, they are comfortable to wear for extended periods.
The Galaxy Buds On feature an ergonomic design to distribute pressure evenly across the ears, offering a secure fit even during workouts or other high-movement activities. Samsung claims it analyzed extensive data on various ear shapes and conducted simulations to optimize the placement of the speakers and batteries.
The earbuds are powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 Sound Platform, enabling them to offer up to 9.5 hours of battery life on a single charge.
To overcome the limitations of an open-ear design, Samsung implemented TwinBoost speakers, which enhance low-frequency sounds. The earbuds also feature automatic volume control to adjust audio levels based on the user's environment. Music and call controls are just a touch away on the back of the device.
Even in quiet environments like a library, Samsung's Audio Leakage Reduction technology prevents sound from escaping, ensuring people nearby cannot hear what is playing.
Using three microphones, a bone-conduction-based Voice Pickup Sensor, and Intelligent Clear Call, the Galaxy Buds On deliver high-quality audio during calls by isolating the user's voice from background noise.
The Galaxy Buds On also feature Gemini Live. You can simply say, “Hey Google, let’s talk live,” to start a conversation with Google's powerful AI voice assistant. You can instantly take voice memos by long-pressing the touch area. Afterward, you can use Bixby to search through these memos, making it an excellent tool for storing ideas.
You can also use Head Gestures to answer or end calls, dismiss alarms, or check notifications on your phone.
The Galaxy Buds On will be available in South Korea starting October 27, 2026. They are priced at KRW 299,000 (approximately $220) and will launch in other countries in phases following their South Korean debut.

source_texts.text:
Samsung quietly launches the Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on Galaxy Buds
Oct 1, 2026 — 1:12 AM ET
- Samsung has quietly launched the Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on wireless earbuds.
- The Buds On feature TwinBoost speakers, Audio Leakage Reduction, automatic volume control, and up to 9.5 hours of playback.
- They also bring Galaxy AI features such as access to Gemini Live, Quick Voice Memo, and head gestures, with a Korean launch set for October 27 at 299,000 won and a global rollout to follow.
Samsung has quietly launched the Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on wireless earbuds under the Galaxy Buds branding. The new wireless earbuds were quietly unveiled alongside the US launch of the Galaxy Tab S12 series and SmartTag 3, although Samsung didn’t give them the same fanfare as its other new hardware.
The Galaxy Buds On have been rumored for quite some time, and their official unveiling confirms Samsung is expanding its wireless earbuds lineup beyond the familiar in-ear design. Instead of sitting inside the ear canal, the Galaxy Buds On use a clip-on design that rests around the ear while leaving the ear canal open.
Design and controls
The design of the new Galaxy Buds On ensures you can hear what’s happening around you while listening to music or having a conversation. Samsung also says the buds put less strain on the ears during extended use.
The company says it analyzed data from different ear shapes and ran simulations to optimize the positioning of the speakers and battery. The Buds On feature an ergonomic design with a larger contact area to distribute pressure more evenly, while the band’s elasticity has been fine-tuned to keep the earbuds securely in place during movement.
You can also control key functions, such as music playback and calls, with a light tap on the back of the earbuds.
The Buds On feature “TwinBoost speakers” that are designed to improve low-frequency performance, along with automatic volume control that adjusts to the surrounding environment. Samsung has also introduced an Audio Leakage Reduction feature designed to reduce sound leakage from the earbuds.
Galaxy Buds On specs and features
Elsewhere, the Galaxy Buds On are powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 Sound Platform and a high-efficiency Class-D amplifier. Samsung claims up to 9.5 hours of continuous music playback on a single charge.
The earbuds also support Samsung’s Intelligent Clear Call technology. They use three microphones, a bone-conduction-based Voice Pickup Unit sensor, and machine learning to separate the wearer’s voice from background noise. Samsung says this setup can help keep calls clear even in noisy environments.
AI and other features
Apart from their specs and unusual design, the Buds On also pack several Galaxy AI features when they’re paired with a compatible Galaxy smartphone or tablet.
For example, users can say, “Hey Google, let’s talk live,” while wearing the Buds On to launch Gemini Live and have a hands-free conversation with Google’s AI assistant.
There’s also a Quick Voice Memo feature that lets you long-press on the touch area of an earbud to instantly start recording a voice memo. These recordings can later be searched using Bixby without needing to pull out the phone.
The feature requires a Galaxy AI-supported device, Samsung’s Voice Recorder, and the Bixby app, and users need to configure the long-press action separately in Settings.
The Buds On also support Head Gestures, allowing users to perform specific actions with their heads. You can answer or end calls, dismiss alarms, or read message notifications by nodding or shaking your head when your hands aren’t available.
Galaxy Buds On price and availability
Samsung will launch the Galaxy Buds On in South Korea first on October 27. They’ll initially be available in a single black color and cost 299,000 won (~$220).
Samsung says the earbuds will subsequently roll out to other global markets, although it hasn’t announced pricing or availability for individual regions yet.
